scripted_findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any external profile
scripted_findings.evidence: None of the 12 crawled page(s) declares Organization, LocalBusiness or similar structured data with sameAs links. Without sameAs, an assistant has nothing distinguishing this brand from others sharing the name, which is the standard cause of mistaken identity.

scripted_findings.title: Interactive controls without an accessible name on 1 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: https://linear.app/changelog: 3/195 controls expose no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, SVG title or image alt. Controls whose name is bound by a JS framework (v-, x-, ng-, :, @, [) were assumed named at runtime and not counted.

scripted_findings.title: No structured data on 4 significant page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 4/12 crawled pages of type ['about', 'blog', 'home', 'pricing'] contain no JSON-LD. Structured data is read by the indexing crawlers that build the search index assistants query, and it states a fact with a type attached. Examples: ['https://linear.app/', 'https://linear.app/plan', 'https://linear.app/about']

Linear selects what appears in Priority by default, with the option to customize it by choosing notification sources or creating a filter. You can also continue using the inbox just as you do today.
